command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('AGG_SW_04','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','PE1','PE2','PE3','SZ_AR'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { `$cmd='display current-configuration'; `$e=[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString(`$cmd); `$a=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$e); `$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_06/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$e); Write-Output ('===== '+`$n+' differences 05 versus 06 ====='); Compare-Object -ReferenceObject (`$a.output -split '\r?\n') -DifferenceObject (`$b.output -split '\r?\n') | Where-Object { `$_.InputObject -notmatch '^(display |Current system time|Last |Route Duration|\s*$)' } }"
